question: interface has no term for a model the vendor hosts and bills but exposes only inside its own editor; both Zed rows need it
why: zed-personal states cli because a headless eval-cli exists in the zed repository and reads the user's own provider keys, while zed-pro's hosted models have no published endpoint. Whether the hosted subscription is reachable from a script decides whether it is capacity or a UI. The interface vocabulary has no term for a hosted model reachable only through the vendor's editor
